en_title: Rockstar Explains Why it Added Consequences to GTA 6's Violence and Crimes
cn_title: Rockstar解释为何为《GTA 6》中的暴力和犯罪行为加入后果
opus_summary: Rockstar负责人Rob Nelson解释了《GTA 6》的犯罪档案系统及更真实的NPC互动。他表示，前作中肆意破坏虽一度有趣，却缺乏实质内容，容易令人厌倦。新作仍允许玩家大开杀戒，但犯罪档案可能因此进入不可挽回的状态。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games boss Rob Nelson has explained why the studio added the divisive criminal profile system to GTA 6 .
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar负责人Rob Nelson解释了工作室为何在《GTA 6》中加入颇具争议的犯罪档案系统。

paragraphs.en: That means players can now point a gun at someone and threaten them, rather than having to beat or kill them to steal their money. The threat of violence is just as prevalent as the violence itself in GTA 6, and it also plays into the morality-adjacent system that is your criminal profile. The game doesn't explicitly punish you for doing bad things, because it's GTA, and you're bound to do bad things. However, it judges you on how harsh you are. If you rob a store with minimal force or only attack people if they draw on you first, attempting to minimize casualties, your profile won't change. If you go in and kill everyone, the level may decrease.
paragraphs.cn: 这意味着玩家现在可以用枪指着别人并威胁他们，而不必为了抢钱而殴打或杀死他们。在《GTA 6》中，暴力威胁与暴力本身一样普遍，它也会影响犯罪档案这一与道德相关的系统。游戏不会明确惩罚你的坏事，因为这是《侠盗猎车手》，你肯定会做坏事。不过，它会根据你手段有多狠来评判你。如果你以最低限度的武力抢劫商店，或只在别人先对你拔枪时才攻击他们，尽量减少伤亡，你的档案就不会改变。如果你进去杀光所有人，等级可能会下降。

paragraphs.en: This prompted Rockstar to expand NPC interactions even further. If you drew a gun in GTA 5, no one cared until it was actively pointed at them. Now, people will begin to quietly scurry away if they see you pull a rifle out of your trunk. Nelson explained that while the powerful rampages were fun for a while in previous games, they lacked substance and would get old quickly. In GTA 6, the process to start mowing people down takes a bit more thought because you don't have an endless pocket of weapons anymore.
paragraphs.cn: 这促使Rockstar进一步扩展NPC互动。在《GTA 5》中，如果你拔出枪，没人会在意，除非你主动把枪指向他们。现在，如果人们看到你从后备厢里拿出一支步枪，就会开始悄悄溜走。Nelson解释说，虽然在前作中大开杀戒能让人痛快一阵子，但这种玩法缺乏实质内容，很快就会让人厌倦。在《GTA 6》中，开始大肆扫射前需要多费一点心思，因为你的口袋里不再有用不完的武器。

paragraphs.en: "You have to call your car," says Nelson. "You have to pop a car trunk and get [a weapon], and now I'm walking, and now people are noticing, but they're sort of sidling away, and it's more believable. And then they're still fleeing in terror, but then there's people who also have guns, and they're shooting at you, or you try to hold somebody up, and they pull a gun, or they grab it, and then you have to deal with them.
paragraphs.cn: 「你得叫来自己的车，」Nelson说，「你得打开汽车后备厢拿出［一把武器］，然后我开始走路，人们注意到了，但他们会悄悄侧身溜走，这样更可信。接着他们还是会惊恐逃跑，但也有人带着枪，他们会向你开枪；或者你试图抢劫某个人，他们会拔枪，或是抓住你的枪，然后你就得对付他们。

paragraphs.en: "And then, you choose. You're trying to jack somebody off a motorcycle, and they pull a gun on you, and you have to blow their head off, and it's like, 'You shouldn't have made me do that!' And so then it has more meaning, and it's more funny in a way when it's a little bit more pointed. And you can still go on those rampages and basically smash your criminal profile until it breaks, and then you enter this irredeemable state, which basically says, 'I reject your criminal profile system! I don't want it.'"
paragraphs.cn: 「然后，你做出选择。你试图把某人从摩托车上拽下来抢车，他们却拔枪指着你，你不得不打爆他们的头，就好像在说：『你不该逼我这么做！』这样一来，它就更有意义了，而且当事情更有针对性一点时，某种程度上也更有趣。你仍然可以大开杀戒，基本上把你的犯罪档案砸个粉碎，然后进入这种无可挽回的状态，这基本上就是在说：『我拒绝你的犯罪档案系统！我不想要它。』」

paragraphs.en: The more realistic approach with GTA 6 has been a bit divisive for purists. Some don't want consequences; they want a power fantasy, and GTA 6 is decidely not that. If you want a supercar, it's going to take you dozens of hours before you can steal one. There's a progression to the chaos. For some, that's more rewarding. For others who want that quick fix, it's cumbersome. It'll be interesting to see how Rockstar looks at all of the responses to the game and how that informs the next GTA.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》更为写实的处理方式在忠实玩家中引发了一些分歧。有些人不想承担后果；他们想要的是一种强大无敌的幻想，而《GTA 6》显然不是这样。如果你想要一辆超级跑车，就得花上几十个小时才能偷到一辆。混乱是循序渐进的。对一些人来说，这更有成就感。对另一些想要迅速获得满足的人来说，这则很繁琐。Rockstar会如何看待对这款游戏的所有反响，以及这些反响将如何影响下一部《侠盗猎车手》，值得关注。

paragraphs.en: Will they go further down this path or will they try to find a greater middle ground? The game certainly isn't hurting despite some vocal critics. GTA 6 is the highest rated game in history on Metacritic and generated nearly $4 billion in revenue in its first 24 hours , making it the biggest entertainment launch in history. IGN gave the game a 10 out of 10 , praising it for its depth and detail.
paragraphs.cn: 他们会沿着这条路走得更远，还是会试图寻找一个更折中的方案？尽管有一些批评者大声表达不满，这款游戏显然没有受到影响。《GTA 6》是Metacritic上历史评分最高的游戏，首发24小时内创造了近40亿美元的收入，成为史上规模最大的娱乐产品首发。IGN给这款游戏打出了10分满分，称赞了它的深度和细节。

paragraphs.en: "Exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered, GTA 6 has not stopped astonishing me since I started it," reads an excerpt from our review. "I regularly find myself in love with video games, but it’s extraordinarily rare that I find myself in complete awe of them. Put simply, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played."
paragraphs.cn: 我们的评测中有这样一段话：「《GTA 6》细节精美，始终充满可供尝试的可能性，制作上毫不妥协；自我开始玩它以来，它就一直令我惊叹。我经常发现自己爱上电子游戏，但一款游戏能让我彻底折服的情况却极为罕见。简单来说，《GTA 6》是我玩过的最令人印象深刻的一款电子游戏。」
